scripts.build: vue-tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && node scripts/check-dependency-boundaries.mjs --scope=web && vite build && node scripts/verify-web-build.mjs
scripts.build:desktop: vue-tsc -p tsconfig.desktop.json && node scripts/check-dependency-boundaries.mjs && vite build --config vite.desktop.config.ts && node scripts/verify-desktop-build.mjs
scripts.verify:phase-b: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:desktop && npm run check:boundaries && npm run check:protocol && npm --prefix ../clients/shared run typecheck && npm --prefix ../clients/shared test && vitest run web/__tests__/architecture web/__tests__/router/routes.test.ts web/__tests__/router/desktopBuildVerifier.test.ts shared/__tests__ desktop/__tests__
